name: uc_merced
description: The UC Merced Land Use dataset is an aerial image classification benchmark containing high-resolution 256x256 images across 21 land-use classes (e.g., residential, agricultural, forest). It is used to evaluate image classification models and feature representations for remote sensing and scene recognition tasks. Due to its modest size and well-defined classes, it is commonly used for model prototyping and transfer-learning experiments.
reputation: A widely used, classical benchmark in remote sensing and aerial image classification research for evaluating image classifiers and feature methods.
